attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a RabbitMQ 4.0.5 cluster (Erlang 26.2.5, installed from the official generic-unix tarball since RHEL9 had no reachable RabbitMQ rpm repo), created a `payments` vhost defaulting to quorum queues, and an `app_user` account scoped to that vhost with full publish/consume permissions. Verified a durable quorum queue (`orders`, replicated across all 3 nodes) survives the loss of any one node and stays consumable from the remaining nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot identity and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
